clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverwing Grove, Illiyana Moonblaze supplies the Alliance champions fighting the Warsong Outriders. She works alongside the Silverwing Sentinels in Ashenvale.

Illiyana Moonblaze keeps supplies for the Silverwing Sentinels at Silverwing Grove. Her post is near the path into Warsong Gulch, where she outfits defenders holding Ashenvale's southern woods against the Warsong clan.

Illiyana equips Alliance volunteers preparing to fight the Warsong clan in Warsong Gulch. As champions earn favor with the Silverwing Sentinels, she provides custom rations, specialized draughts, and fine weapons for woodland skirmishes. She also repairs weapons and armor for weary fighters returning from the front, keeping the Sentinels supplied for war.
